messages:
Olivia (CS): Heads-up — running a mid-market Drop-In pilot next week. 45m total (30m demo + 15m Q&A). max 6 orgs per slot, 2 attendees per org. aim: shorten time-to-first-call and walk through a migration checklist. sign-up poll: https://rwd.link/dropin-poll :point_up:

Mike (Enablement): Ill take the NA morning slot (PDT). will bring the dedicated->private migration checklist and a tiny infra gotchas slide. :thumbsup:

Sana (Onboarding): EU afternoon (14:00 BST) good for me. i'll prepare a 10-slide quickstart and a one-pager pre-req note. propose we ask attendees to bring org admin + API key.

Priya (Solutions): i'll partner on the demo. recommend reserving one slot for customers in renewal window so renewal teams can surface billing/throughput questions. also suggest we auto-upload recordings internally and share to attendees.

Olivia (CS): agree on renewal-targeted slot. recorder on by default; we'll scrub PII in post. draft agenda below 5m total:

```
1) 5m - intro & goals
2) 10m - quickstart (account, API keys, simple requests)
3) 12m - demo: routing, batching, cost levers (three short scenarios)
4) 13m - migration checklist + common gotchas
5) 5m - Q&A and next steps
```

Mike (Enablement): looks reasonable. i'll tighten examples to 3 canned scenarios: chat, embeddings, fallback routing.

Sana (Onboarding): +1. also propose a 3-question pre-read so we can tailor demos (region, infra, primary use-case). preread form: https://rwd.link/dropin-preread

EnablementBot: RSVP updated 5m: Olivia (CS), Mike (Enablement), Sana (Onboarding), Priya (Solutions). Seats left: NA slot 2, EU slot 4.

Olivia (CS): logistics: create per-slot Zoom links (no PMI). attach slides to calendar invite and cc cs-ops. i'll make the calendar series once poll closes (48h). reminder: /remind @channel 1 day before.

Priya (Solutions): i'll draft renewal-slot blurb: "For teams approaching renewal or capacity planning: bring billing and throughput questions." will post copy here.

Mike (Enablement): request: enable live captions for APAC-friendly slots and record transcripts.

Olivia (CS): yes — captions + transcript. follow-up plan: Sana to send recording, slides, checklist, and feedback survey within 24h. feedback survey: NPS + one improvement question: https://rwd.link/dropin-feedback

Sana (Onboarding): happy to own share-out. who is hosting per region?

Olivia (CS): volunteers: Mike = NA host, Sana = EU host, Priya = renewal slot lead. i'll finalize after poll closes. thanks! :raised_hands:

Priya (Solutions): i'll add two quick case studies (5m) to the deck to show short wins before the demo.

Olivia (CS): final note: enforce capacity on sign-up (6 orgs/slot, 2 attendees max). we'll confirm seat list 6 hours before each slot.
